name: @puppi/adapter-notion
description: Source connector for the Notion API: bearer integration token, Notion-Version header, cursor pages of users, search, and data source queries.

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/openapi.ts --export-type --root-types --empty-objects-unknown --default-non-nullable=false && puppi-write-operations openapi.json src/operations.ts && pnpm exec oxfmt --write src/openapi.ts src/operations.ts
